resources.string: Inspect storage by project and Runtime component, and manage shared toolchains and reclaimable caches
Compare Studio-managed Runtime storage by project and see the Python, Node.js, and other managed components.
No project Runtime storage to display.
Project source is stored in Android shared storage. This screen manages Runtime data, shared toolchains, and caches without deleting project source.
Tap the project card to open its root file tree

This removes Studio-managed Python/Node.js Runtime workspaces, dependencies, logs, and runtime state for this project, but not project source. The environment must be prepared again before the next run.

Unassociated Runtime data is a Python/Node.js workspace or runtime-state set with no current matching Studio project. Its source may be deleted, renamed, moved, or simply outside the current project root.
This removes all managed Runtime data for %1$s, including Python/Node.js workspaces and runtime state. It currently has no matching Studio project; project source may still exist elsewhere.

This removes the %1$d currently identified unassociated Runtime data sets and should reclaim about %2$s. Normal project Runtime data and project source are preserved. Source may simply have been renamed, moved, or be outside the current project root. The operation is blocked if any unassociated Runtime still has a live process.
At least one unassociated Runtime still has a live process and cannot be deleted. Stop that process and refresh storage usage.
This removes the proot-distro download/image cache without deleting installed Ubuntu, project Runtime data, or project source. A future Runtime reinstall may need to download data again.

This removes only reusable pip cache data. Dependencies already installed in project Python virtual environments remain installed. Rebuilding an environment later may require downloading packages again.
This removes only reusable npm package cache data. node_modules inside project Runtime workspaces are preserved. Preparing a Node.js environment later may require downloading packages again.
This removes downloaded apt package archives only. It does not uninstall Python, Node.js, or any installed Ubuntu packages.

This removes toolchains downloaded and managed by Studio, such as managed Node.js. Project source and project Runtime workspaces are preserved, but affected projects may need Prepare again before the next run. The operation is blocked while any project is running.
This removes Ubuntu, system-level runtimes, all project Runtime data, shared toolchains, and Runtime caches. Project source in Android shared storage is preserved. Stop all projects first.
After removal, every project that depends on the Ubuntu Runtime must reinstall/prepare its runtime environment before it can run again. Continue?
Ubuntu runtime removed. Project source was preserved.
A project is still running. Stop all projects before modifying the shared Runtime or managed toolchains.
proot-distro was not found, so runtime storage cannot be inspected.
